thought.text: I see from the old logs that the server WAS running before (just with database not configured - which we fixed!). Let me restore the package.json properly:

reasoning_content:
Looking at the logs, I can see that the OLD version was working with a "database not configured" message - that's what we fixed earlier! The server was actually running but complaining about the database config.

The issue is that after my changes, the package.json got corrupted and now nothing works.

Let me restore the original package.json from the backup and just make the minimal fix needed - remove the "type": "module" line.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Restore from backup
print("=== Restoring package.json ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/.env.bak*")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check if backup exists
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -10 /opt/areloria/.env.bak 2>/dev/null | head -5")
print("env backup content (first few lines):")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# The issue is package.json was damaged. Let me check what we have
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -20 /opt/areloria/package.json")
print("\nCurrent package.json:")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
